# library
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cmdstanr)
library(posterior)
```

# Data loading
```{r}
# 1. Retrieving the file list
files <- list.files("Micro_Analysis_Bayesian", pattern = "vis_|invis_", full.names = TRUE)

# 2. Load and format all files
d_timeline_20251002 <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  # Extract condition and delta
  fname <- basename(f)
  condition <- ifelse(str_detect(fname, "^vis"), "visible_pair", "invisible_pair")
  delta <- as.numeric(str_extract(fname, "\\d+\\.\\d+"))
  
  # Loading & Lengthening
  dat <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = contains("z_S_t"),
      names_to = "key",
      values_to = "z_S_t"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      # "z_S_t__20170706_01_02_01" → "20170706_01_02_01"
      pair_session = str_remove(key, "z_S_t__"),
      pair_id = str_extract(pair_session, "^\\d{8}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}"),
      session = str_extract(pair_session, "\\d{2}$"),
      condition = condition,
      delta = delta
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(condition, pair_id, session, t_center, z_S_t, delta)
  dat
})

# Data Verification
d_timeline_20251002 <- d_timeline_20251002 %>% mutate(session=as.integer(session))
d_timeline_20251002
```

```{r}
make_stan_data <- function(df, resp_var) {
  # Individual ID assignment
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      pair_id_int = as.integer(factor(pair_id)),
      session_id_int = as.integer(factor(session)),
      bin_id = as.integer(factor(t_center)),
      is_visible = if_else(condition == "visible_pair", 1L, 0L)
    )

  # Defect Location Specification
  y_vec <- df[[resp_var]]
  obs_idx <- which(!is.na(y_vec))
  mis_idx <- which(is.na(y_vec))

  stan_data <- list(
    N         = nrow(df),
    N_obs     = length(obs_idx),
    N_mis     = length(mis_idx),
    N_pair    = max(df$pair_id_int),
    N_session = max(df$session_id_int),
    N_bin     = max(df$bin_id),
    obs_idx   = obs_idx,
    mis_idx   = mis_idx,
    pair_id   = df$pair_id_int,
    session_id= df$session_id_int,
    bin       = df$bin_id,
    is_visible= df$is_visible,
    y_obs     = y_vec[obs_idx]
  )
  return(stan_data)
}

```


```{r}
make_init_fun <- function(stan_data) {
  y_init <- if (length(stan_data$y_obs) > 0) mean(stan_data$y_obs, na.rm=TRUE) else 0
  list(
    y_mis = rep(y_init, stan_data$N_mis),
    mu0 = y_init,
    mu_pair = rep(y_init, stan_data$N_pair),
    mu_sess_init = matrix(y_init, stan_data$N_pair, stan_data$N_session),
    sigma_pair = 1,
    sigma_sess_init = 1,
    mu_state = rep(y_init, stan_data$N_bin),
    sigma_mu = 1,
    beta0 = 0,
    beta_tan = rep(0, stan_data$N_bin-1),
    sigma_beta = 1,
    sigma_obs = 1
  )
}

```


```{r}
# Generate a stan data list for z_S_t/S_excess for each delta
delta_vals <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.5, 1.0)
resp_vars <- c("z_S_t")

stan_data_list <- list()
for (delta in delta_vals) {
  for (resp in resp_vars) {
    df_sub <- d_timeline_20251002 %>% filter(delta == !!delta)
    nm <- paste0(resp, "_delta", gsub("\\.", "", as.character(delta)))
    stan_data_list[[nm]] <- make_stan_data(df_sub, resp)
  }
}

```


```{r}
mod <- cmdstan_model("04_ssm_chewing_missing_Bayesian.stan")
```

```{r}
output_dir <- "stan_fits" # Specify the save directory

options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
set.seed(1234)

fit_list <- list()

for (nm in names(stan_data_list)) {
  message(sprintf("Fitting: %s", nm))
  fit <- mod$sample(
    data = stan_data_list[[nm]],
    chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4,
    iter_sampling = 5000, iter_warmup = 1000,
    seed = 123,
    refresh = 500,
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    max_treedepth = 15,
    init = function() make_init_fun(stan_data_list[[nm]])
  )
  fit$save_object(file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("fit_", nm, "_human.rds")))
  fit_list[[nm]] <- fit
  summary_df <- fit$summary(
    variables = NULL,
    posterior::default_summary_measures(),
    posterior::default_convergence_measures(),
    extra_quantiles = ~posterior::quantile2(., probs = c(.025, .975))
  )
  summary_df$condition <- nm
  write.csv(summary_df, file = file.path(output_dir, paste0("summary_", nm, "_human.csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# Plot
## delta=0.1
```{r}
# 1. Loading summary files
df_sum <- read_csv("stan_fits/summary_z_S_t_delta01_human.csv")

# 2. Extract beta_state, bin number, and determine the confidence interval
df_beta <- df_sum %>%
  filter(str_detect(variable, "^beta_state\\[")) %>%
  mutate(
    bin = as.integer(str_extract(variable, "\\d+")),
    mean = mean,
    q025 = q2.5,
    q975 = q97.5,
    sigpos = if_else(q025 > 0, 1, 0),    # Positive direction significant
    signeg = if_else(q975 < 0, 1, 0)     # Negative direction significant
  )

# 3. Function to obtain consecutive intervals using run-length encoding
get_sig_ranges <- function(sigvec) {
  rle_sig <- rle(sigvec)
  lens <- rle_sig$lengths
  vals <- rle_sig$values
  ends <- cumsum(lens)
  starts <- ends - lens + 1
  tibble(start=starts[vals==1], end=ends[vals==1])
}
sig_ranges_pos <- get_sig_ranges(df_beta$sigpos)
sig_ranges_neg <- get_sig_ranges(df_beta$signeg)

# 4. Plot
p <- ggplot(df_beta, aes(x = bin, y = mean)) +
  # Top (red) band
  geom_rect(
    data = sig_ranges_pos,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#D55E00", alpha = 0.10
  ) +
  # Bottom (blue) band
  geom_rect(
    data = sig_ranges_neg,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.10
  ) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975), alpha = 0.2, fill = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "Time bin", y = expression(beta(t) ~ "mean ± 95%CI")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)
print(p)

```
